# The two postmen

<!-- STEP id="history" -->
Speed as distance divided by time is an old idea in India. It appears in the Aryabhatiya (5th century CE). The Ganitakaumudi (14th century CE) asks: two postmen are 210 yojanas apart. They walk towards each other at 9 and 5 yojanas a day. When do they meet?

<!-- STEP id="meet" -->
Together they close 9 + 5 = 14 yojanas each day. 210 / 14 = 15 days. By then one postman has walked 9 x 15 = 135 yojanas, and the other 5 x 15 = 75 yojanas.
